newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates firmer on routine payments.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates firmer on routine payments.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates rose slightly at midday on Wednesday on continuous early-month payments that tightened market liquidity, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate was at 4.985 percent against Tuesday's 4.859 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.90-5.00 against 4.80-4.95. Dealers said they expected stable to slightly firmer rates on Thursday as liquidity in October should stay comparatively loose.
Bond market showed stable and narrow-range trade, with the seven-year 85/3 bond yield at 5.5975 against 5.6000-6025.
